parsed.post: Discarding DEPTH=12 (0.9722) as it regressed from my best (0.9686). Depth-12 seems to hit a capacity/stability ceiling within the 5-minute budget. Reverting to DEPTH=10. Since depth scaling is saturating, I'll try increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to add width-based capacity instead.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH 10 and increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to test if widening the model improves convergence more effectively than deepening it.
